title: 第11章 还定三秦
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦朝灭亡后，项羽以“西楚霸王”之名分封18路诸侯，却因利益分配不公引发众怒，他将刘邦封至闭塞的汉中，又把关中一分为三，交给秦朝降将章邯等人，试图锁死刘邦东进之路，田荣、彭越等诸侯也因对分封结果不满相继反叛，更让刘邦找到了“天下共讨项羽”的借口。

前206年8月，刘邦采纳韩信之计，明修栈道，暗度陈仓，突袭关中，平定三秦。刘邦能迅速平定三秦，暗度陈仓是关键，兵力占优又是出其不意的突然袭击，用章邯的方式打败章邯，赢得漂亮。

但有一点不可忽略，那就是三秦中其实只有章邯一直在打，司马欣和董翳稍作抵抗，见势不妙很快就投降了，刘邦甚至来不及对两个降王所部进行收编、对其地盘进行接收，就迫不及待地率军东进。

在此之前，9月，汉军先头部队就奉命出武关，先于刘邦大军出关，之所以这么快，是因为不得不快，他们的使命不是攻城掠地，而是接人，接刘邦的老婆孩子。刘邦入蜀时可没带家属，直到现在他的家人还在楚地项羽的地盘上。如今已然开战，他可不想老婆孩子被项羽抓住当人质。

也许有人会说，刘邦和项羽尚未直接开战，何至于此？当然至于，刘邦打章邯就等于跟项羽开战，因为章邯乃至三秦都是项羽封的，他们都是由项羽主导的“戏亭分封”体系下的诸侯。刘邦对三秦开战，就等于对项羽宣战。项羽自己可以杀韩王韩成，那叫维护秩序。刘邦攻击章邯就是破坏规矩，那叫扰乱秩序，因为规则是项羽定的，所以项羽可以随心所欲，但刘邦不可以。

刘邦在沛县的大哥王陵此时正屯兵于南阳，距刘邦的老家最近，他派兵去迎接刘邦的家属。项羽得到情报，立即发兵将其挡在阳夏。

王陵是沛县的土豪，当年刘邦尚未发迹之时，还要叫王陵一声大哥。正因为他是当地土豪、刘邦的老乡，他才对刘邦有抵触情绪，沛县老乡大都去投刘邦了，就他不肯，这个心理就跟雍齿看不上刘邦是一个意思，大家都是老乡，知根知底，刘邦是什么玩意儿他们最清楚不过，人都是贵远贱近，越是了解，就会越缺少敬畏，你得保持神秘感才有权威，才有气场，才有威严，才能镇住手下那帮人。王陵就是太了解刘邦了，才不甘心做刘邦的手下。

刘邦西征入关从他的地盘路过，他也没有加入的打算，直到此时，刘邦反攻三秦成功，成为名副其实的汉王，兵多将广，实力强大，王陵才不得不服，率部数千于南阳归附。

项羽先未动刘邦的家眷，反而将王陵的母亲接到军中，当然也可以说是劫持到楚军大营，王陵的使者奉命到项羽军中营救，项羽为了拉王陵入伙，有意安排王母与使者见面，当着项羽的面，他们又不好多说，于是，简单寒暄过后，使者告辞离去。

王母在送别使者时才找到机会私下对其哭诉，告诉他：“要好好辅佐汉王，不要挂念我，汉王是忠厚长者，将来必得天下。不要因为我怀有二心，我这里只有以死相送了！”说完自刎而死。

项羽勃然大怒，人即使死了也要报复，他下令将王母的尸体用大锅烹煮泄愤。项羽的做法只会让人觉得他冷血嗜杀，并将王陵彻底推到刘邦那边。

张良似乎认为项羽很好忽悠，双方已经撕破脸，他还写信给项羽说：“汉王只是想得关中，如约即止，不敢东向。”又将齐魏两国的往来书信交给项羽，里面的内容不用问，都是反对项羽的。张良还在信中说：“齐国想和赵国联合攻楚，您要早做准备才是。”

Page (1/3)

After the fall of the Qin Dynasty, Xiang Yu enfeoffed 18 princes in the name of "Overlord of Western Chu", but the unfair distribution of benefits aroused public outrage. He sealed Liu Bang to the isolated Hanzhong, and divided Guanzhong into three parts, giving them to the Qin Dynasty general Zhang Han and others, trying to block Liu Bang's eastward advance. Tian Rong, Peng Yue and other princes also rebelled one after another because they were dissatisfied with the result of the enfeoffment, which gave Liu Bang an excuse to "descend Xiang Yu".

In August 206 BC, Liu Bang adopted Han Xin's plan, built a plank road openly, secretly attacked Chencang, raided Guanzhong, and pacified the Three Qin Dynasty.Liu Bang was able to quickly put down the Three Qin Dynasties. The secret attack on Chen Cang was the key. He had superior military strength and an unexpected surprise attack. He used Zhang Han's method to defeat Zhang Han and win a beautiful victory.

But one thing cannot be ignored, that is, in the Three Qin Dynasty, only Zhang Han has been fighting. Sima Xin and Dong Yi resisted for a while, but soon surrendered when they saw that the situation was not good. Liu Bang did not even have time to recruit the two subordinates and take over their territory, so he couldn't wait to lead his army eastward.

Prior to this, in September, the leading troops of the Han army were ordered to leave Wuguan before Liu Bang's army. The reason why they were so fast was because they had to be fast. Their mission was not to attack the city and seize territory, but to pick up people, Liu Bang's wife and children.Liu Bang did not bring his family with him when he entered Shu. Until now, his family is still in Xiang Yu's territory in Chu.Now that the war has begun, he does not want his wife and children to be captured and used as hostages by Xiang Yu.

Some people may say that Liu Bang and Xiang Yu have not yet started a direct war, so why is this happening?Of course, Liu Bang's attack on Zhang Han is tantamount to starting a war with Xiang Yu, because Zhang Han and even the Three Qin Dynasties were granted by Xiang Yu, and they were all princes under the "Xiting enfeoffment" system led by Xiang Yu.Liu Bang's declaration of war against San Qin was equivalent to a declaration of war against Xiang Yu.Xiang Yu himself could kill Han Cheng, the king of Han, and that would be called maintaining order.Liu Bang's attack on Zhang Han was breaking the rules, which was called disrupting order, because the rules were set by Xiang Yu, so Xiang Yu could do whatever he wanted, but Liu Bang could not.

Liu Bang's eldest brother in Pei County, Wang Ling, was stationing troops in Nanyang at this time, which was closest to Liu Bang's hometown. He sent troops to greet Liu Bang's family members.Xiang Yu got the information and immediately sent troops to block it in Yangxia.

Wang Ling was a local tycoon in Peixian County. When Liu Bang had not yet made his fortune, he still called Wang Ling his elder brother.Precisely because he is a local tycoon and a fellow villager of Liu Bang, he has resistance to Liu Bang. Most of the fellow villagers in Pei County have gone to Liu Bang, but he refuses. This mentality is the same as Yong Chi's disdain for Liu Bang. Everyone is a fellow villager and knows his roots.They know the bottom line, what Liu Bang is, but they know best. People are noble and inferior, and the more they understand, the less awe they will lack. Only by maintaining a sense of mystery can you have authority, aura, and majesty, so as to control the people under your command.Wang Ling knew Liu Bang so well that he was unwilling to be Liu Bang's subordinate.

Liu Bang passed by his territory during his Western Expedition and he had no intention of joining. Until then, Liu Bang successfully counterattacked the Three Qin Dynasties and became a veritable king of Han. He had many soldiers and generals and was powerful. Wang Ling had no choice but to surrender and led thousands of troops to surrender in Nanyang.

Xiang Yu did not touch Liu Bang's family first, but instead took Wang Ling's mother into the army. Of course, it can also be said that she hijacked the Chu army's camp. Wang Ling's envoy was ordered to rescue Xiang Yu's army. In order to attract Wang Ling to join the army, Xiang Yu deliberately arranged for the Queen Mother to meet the envoy. In front of Xiang Yu, they could not say much, so after a brief greeting, the envoy said goodbye and left.

When the Queen Mother was bidding farewell to the envoy, she found an opportunity to cry to him privately, telling him: "You must assist the King of Han well and don't miss me. The King of Han is a loyal and loyal man, and he will conquer the world in the future. Don't have second thoughts because of me. I have no choice but to die!" After saying this, he committed suicide.

Xiang Yu was furious and wanted revenge even if he died. He ordered the queen mother's body to be cooked in a cauldron to vent his anger.Xiang Yu's actions will only make people think that he is cold-blooded and murderous, and will completely push Wang Ling to Liu Bang's side.

Zhang Liang seemed to think that Xiang Yu was easy to deceive, and the two sides were already at odds. He even wrote to Xiang Yu, saying: "The king of Han only wants to capture Guanzhong. He will stop as promised and does not dare to go eastward." He also handed over the letters between Qi and Wei to Xiang Yu. No need to ask about the contents, they were all against Xiang Yu.Zhang Liang also said in the letter: "Qi wants to join forces with Zhao to attack Chu, so you have to make preparations in advance."
